acceptance: Profiles arrive only in verified evidence and are bound to grant, epoch and runtime; plans from an earlier epoch fail until rebound against unchanged authority; stale or out-of-order profiles cannot replace newer ones.

positive.fixture: reauthentication then rebind; environment, capability, tenant and version changes invalidate plans; digests are canonical

negative.fixture: successor grant, older or replayed profile, hand-built or foreign-runtime profile

security_and_source_permissions: Profiles exist only inside verified evidence.
performance_memory_storage: Digest work is one SHA-256 per observation.
known_limitations: Plans are bound by the caller through PlanRef; wiring into the planner is B15 onward
